parsed_json.up: Select compound ChEMBL identifier, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL identifier, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Join compound_records on activities.record_id and docs on compound_records.doc_id to retrieve compound_key and pubmed_id_or_doi. Filter for target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4282 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
